newsitem.title: USA: Dow Jones says takeover report 'nonsense'.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones says takeover report 'nonsense'.

text.p: Dow Jones & Co. Inc. said Friday a Business Week report that Reuters Holdings Plc has expressed interest in buying, merging or forming a joint venture with Dow Jones is "nonsense."
"This report is nonsense," Dow Jones spokesman Roger May said.
Earlier, May had called the article "pure speculation" and cited the company's standard policy of not commenting on market rumours.
But he said due to the day's activity in Dow Jones stock, he was making the additional comment on the report.
"Obviously there is a lot of activity going on today (in Dow Jones shares) and it's obviously in response to the Business Week article," he said.
Dow Jones' stock was up $2.25 at $40.75 on the New York Stock Exchange at midday. Reuters was down $2.1875 at $62.5625 in Nasdaq trading.
A Reuters spokesman earlier declined to comment on the report, saying the company "never addresses speculation or rumour of this sort."
In its Feb. 10 issue released on Thursday, Business Week said Reuters had approached some of the controlling shareholders of Dow Jones expressing interest in making a deal.
